stem: Voltmarkt's month-to-date spend report runs from the 1st of the month up to and including yesterday, the last complete day. On the morning of 6 October, the earbuds campaign on paid social shows daily spend of €180 on 1 October, €210 on 2 October, €195 on 3 October, €225 on 4 October and €140 on 5 October, plus €35 so far today. What is the campaign's month-to-date spend? Give it in euros as a whole number.
